evidence.description: SSM2 uses a single-wire K-line shared with the OBD-II ISO 9141 path (DLC pin 7); SSM1/SSM0 use manufacturer-discretionary pins with different electrical levels

transport.notes: SSM2 K-line path inferred for the target era; SSM1 pins 12/13 require 5V TTL hardware and remain unverified on this vehicle

protocol.notes: Protocol family documented; message-level details still under research

notes: Interface path only. SSM access does not establish which modules exist on the target vehicle. The generic ELM327 OBD-II adapter is NOT an SSM interface.
